title: The Crash (-30%)
spoken_text: Equitas Small Finance Bank just crashed 30% in last 48 hours.

title: Market Panic & Resignation
spoken_text: Every headline is screaming CEO resigns! Panic selling at 52-week low. Retail investors are just panicking and also whispering is this another bank story?

title: Pause and Investigate
spoken_text: Let us pause and take a breath and understand the facts with happy investing.

title: CEO Resignation Fact 01
spoken_text: Fact number one. Why did the CEO resign? Because his daughter co-founded a housing finance company.

title: Disclosure to RBI & Board
spoken_text: Was there any fraud? No. There was zero loans, zero fund transfers, and 100% disclosed to RBI and also to the board.

title: Fundamentals Fact 02
spoken_text: Fact number two is the bank failing fundamentally? Look at the numbers.

title: Highest Profit in History
spoken_text: In last quarter, Equitas printed 218 crores net profit. That is highest profit in the bank's entire history.

title: Asset Quality & Net NPA
spoken_text: And look at the bad loans just dropped to zero point seven percentage.
